name: Seated Side Stretch
description: A long, easy reach to the side while you sit.

steps.title: Sit tall
steps.text: Place both feet flat and rest one hand on your thigh.

steps.title: Reach up and over
steps.text: Raise the other arm overhead and lean gently to the side, as if reaching toward a far wall. Breathe slowly.

steps.title: Come back and switch
steps.text: Return to the middle and repeat on the other side. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
